'''''Frankenia laevis''''', commonly ''' sea heath''',  is a low shrub in the family [[Frankeniaceae]]. It is native to south-west Europe and Britain and to northwestern Africa, including [[Macaronesia]].<ref name=POWO_366294-1/> It grows on the coast. It is rare in Britain.<ref name=UKWF/>

==Distribution==
''Frankenia laevis'' is native to the south-west of Europe (the [[Balearic Islands]], [[Corsica]], [[France]], [[Italy]], [[Portugal]], [[Sardinia]], and [[Spain]]), [[Sicily]], [[Great Britain]], the [[Azores]], and the west of north Africa ([[Algeria]], [[Morocco]] and [[Tunisia]]).<ref name=POWO_366294-1/>
